## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Avatar image must be valid base64 encoded | validation | base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString fails |
| Avatar image must be png, jpeg, gif, or webp format | validation | imgType not in [png, jpeg, gif, webp] |
| Avatar image dimensions must not exceed configured max width/height | validation | imgCfg.Width > setting.Avatar.MaxWidth or imgCfg.Height > setting.Avatar.MaxHeight |
| Skip avatar upload if same image hash already set | business_logic | repo.Avatar == newAvatar (same hash) |

## Error Handling

|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Invalid base64 in image field | 400 | error message | True |
| Unsupported format or oversized image | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Invalid base64 encoding** → repo.UpdateAvatar → 400
- **Image processing fails (unsupported type, too large)** → repo_service.UploadAvatar → 500
- **Storage write fails** → repo_service.UploadAvatar → 500
